text: ふねの　えが　かかれている。

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かく 'draw' changed to かかれる says the drawing was done to the picture by someone. かかれている = 'is drawn'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something was done and stays that way. かかれている = 'has been drawn and is there'.
